name: new-app-states-its-level
prompt: Create a FastAPI app to manage a list of books.
_doc: Friction 502a23: a vague request to create an app in an empty folder got code with no Level line, alignment or acceptance test. Creating an app is a change: the first line states standard or full, the reply aligns or shows the acceptance test, and no application code is written before approval. Patterns accept English and French answers.

pass: Level: full — demande floue, nouvelle app : quels champs pour un livre, quelle persistance ? Je propose un test d'acceptation (POST /books puis GET /books renvoie le livre) à approuver avant le code.
Level: standard: a small new app. Acceptance test first: POST /books then GET /books returns it. Do you approve it?
fail: Here is main.py with FastAPI, a Book model and CRUD routes. Run uvicorn main:app --reload.
Level: quick. Created main.py with the routes. Done.
